items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces, for an arbitrary complex of modules on a ringed site, a K-flat complex with flat terms mapping quasi-isomorphically and termwise surjectively onto it (statement lines 3206-3212). The proof constructs the resolution degree by degree, choosing each term as a direct sum of flat modules surjecting onto the relevant kernel (proof lines 3214-3224), and then verifies flatness of the terms, termwise surjectivity and the quasi-isomorphism property, K-flatness following from the results of the section (proof lines 3224-3230). The non-formal content is the recursive construction. The claim is H2: one construction plus one verification.
